1479-2841-5235-8293.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Brokers Hideout.
1479-2841-5235-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Brokers Hideout.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3169-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3169-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-6633-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-1879-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1879-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-2267-3240-6462.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4446-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-4446-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

1512-3525-4289.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {U}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
Repeat.

1865-2232-7827-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
1865-2232-7827-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

1003-2232-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {2} at most if you control fewer than eight Treasures
1003-2232-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Treasures.
1003-2232-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {6} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {2} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
If needed, activate up to two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C} for each one sacrificed.
Repeat.
1003-2232-4541-5705.notes: If you control seven or more Treasures, use at least seven Treasures to cast Marut. If you use eight Treasures, forego step 13.

369-2730-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

628-2292-7187.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hovel Hurler.
When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-955-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-4676-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Elegant Edgecrafters trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

826-1636-2292-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

147-2171-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-5147.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1753-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
1753-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4659-6772.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-4659-6772.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4050-4331-6741.manaNeeded: {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
4050-4331-6741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven multicolored permanents.
4050-4331-6741.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Robots, adding {1}{W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Infinite Guideline Station from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4053-4785-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-4785-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

2781-5241.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima's Student.
2781-5241.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Sakashima's Student. Choose to have Sakashima's Student enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2033-6218-6627.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-6218-6627.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-6218-6627.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2018-2921-3826.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-2921-3826.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Medicine Runner.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

348-2178-2577-6351.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2577-6351.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2011-6307.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures with total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Luxurious Locomotive.
Luxurious Locomotive does not have summoning sickness.
2011-6307.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive as an attacker.
Luxurious Locomotive triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. 
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
2011-6307.notes: You may attack with a Warrior each combat phase to get infinite creature tokens with haste.

1912-2060-5140-6260.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-6260.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

997-1636-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
997-1636-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

186-2429-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
186-2429-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1850-2328-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Jungle Hollow from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Jungle Hollow, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Jungle Hollow trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

1462-2929-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

841-2034-4544-4677.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2034-4544-4677.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Elemental token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

539-2335-3467.notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Barrenton Medic.
539-2335-3467.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving Barrenton Medic +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-2313-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-2313-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1429-4535-5256.description:
Sacrifice Lesser Masticore to Altar of Dementia milling a player.
Lesser Masticore returns to the battlefield with persist.
Good-Fortune Unicorn gives Lesser Masticore a +1/+1 counter removing the -1/-1 counter from persist.
Repeat.
